title: FREE Halo Pelican in MSFS 2024 VR — Arcade toy or flying brick?
description:
To celebrate Halo's 25th anniversary, the legendary UNSC D77-TC Pelican has officially landed in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024—and you can grab it for FREE in the MSFS Marketplace until November 17th! 

Strapping into the Pimax Crystal Light, we experience this massive dropship at true 1:1 scale in VR. On paper, the Pelican looks like pure arcade fun, until a wrong throttle input or missed flight-mode switch drops you out of the sky like a brick. Today we test the VR cockpit immersion, walk through the cold & dark startup, break down the VTOL hover-to-cruise transition, test what actually works on the autopilot, and push the Pelican all the way into orbit.

📌 Aircraft Featured: UNSC D77-TC Pelican by Microsoft/Asobo
📌 Simulator: Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS 2024)
📌 Headset: Pimax Crystal Light ➡️ check below for a discount code if you consider buying one

⚠️ Grab it while it's free: Open the MSFS 2024 Marketplace and search "Pelican" before November 17th!

💬 Let me know in the comments: Can you guess the two locations we flew over from space?
